body.intent: Risk warnings, never blocks: rhiza health and rhiza workflow check warn when a workflow runs autonomously with bypassPermissions and can be triggered by outside input (a schedule, or requests carrying --ref), naming the workflow and saying outside text reaches agents with no permission checks; rhiza request --ref prints a one-line note when the workflow it will run is such a one. The workflows guide gains a section on outside input: what the warning means, that Rhiza cannot see what a scheduled command does, and the usual mitigations (a person gates intake, a narrower permission mode, owner signoff). Nothing is refused or fenced. Follows decisions workflows-are-the-rules and warn-dont-safeguard (PR #353).
